data.gender_notes: Bartley is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bartley is derived from the Old English words 'beorht' meaning bright or glorious, and 'leah' meaning a clearing in a forest or a farm. This name was traditionally given to boys born on farms or in rural areas, as a reflection of their strong and hardworking nature. The name Bartley carries the meaning “Bright, glorious, son of farmer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bartley usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, glorious, son of farmer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of light and radiance, symbolizing faith and the power of God.
